resource_optimization.mapping: LUT structure off, now the build script default; other official area mapping and placement settings retained.
resource_optimization.fat32_mount: Reuse one-bit right shifts over up to seven cycles instead of a variable barrel shifter.
resource_optimization.fat32_scan: Keep only directory fields consumed by the scanner. Serialize sector address arithmetic with one full-width adder and single-bit shifts, adding 4 to 11 clocks before each request while preserving address values, directory capacity, commit timing, fragmented chains and error behavior.
resource_optimization.bmp_load: Bound row, padding and write counters by configuration; keep full-width invalid-header checks and error priority.
resource_optimization.image_path: One shared raster and one round-robin SDRAM writer serve old/new background and cover. Keep each layer's double-bank cache, metadata CDC and error checks. Register the owner one cycle before command validation/ACK to remove the new internal timing violation.
